items.source: RedisCacheManager defaults to a lock-free RedisCacheWriter for reading and writing binary values. Lock-free caching improves throughput. The lack of entry locking can lead to overlapping, non-atomic commands for the Cache putIfAbsent and clean operations, as those require multiple commands to be sent to Redis. The locking counterpart prevents command overlap by setting an explicit lock key and checking against presence of this key, which leads to additional requests and potential command wait times.
items.translation: RedisCacheManager 默认使用无锁的 RedisCacheWriter 来读写二进制值。 无锁缓存能够提高吞吐量。 由于缺乏条目锁定，Cache 的 putIfAbsent 和 clean 操作可能会导致重叠且非原子的命令，因为这些操作需要向 Redis 发送多个命令。 带锁的实现通过设置显式的锁键并检查该键是否存在来防止命令重叠，但这会导致额外的请求以及潜在的命令等待时间。

items.source: The cache implementation defaults to use KEYS and DEL to clear the cache. KEYS can cause performance issues with large keyspaces. Therefore, the default RedisCacheWriter can be created with a BatchStrategy to switch to a SCAN-based batch strategy. The SCAN strategy requires a batch size to avoid excessive Redis command round trips:

items.source: By default RedisCache, statistics are disabled. Use RedisCacheManagerBuilder.enableStatistics() to collect local hits and misses through RedisCache#getStatistics(), returning a snapshot of the collected data.
items.translation: 默认情况下，RedisCache 的统计功能处于禁用状态。 使用 RedisCacheManagerBuilder.enableStatistics() 可通过 RedisCache#getStatistics() 收集本地 命中 和 未命中 数据，并返回所收集数据的快照。

items.source: Spring Data Redis’s Cache implementation supports time-to-live (TTL) expiration on cache entries. Users can either configure the TTL expiration timeout with a fixed Duration or a dynamically computed Duration per cache entry by supplying an implementation of the new RedisCacheWriter.TtlFunction interface.
items.translation: Spring Data Redis 的 ``Cache`实现支持缓存条目的生存时间(TTL)过期。用户可以通过提供新的``RedisCacheWriter.TtlFunction`接口的实现，以固定``Duration`或为每个缓存条目动态计算``Duration`的方式配置 TTL 过期超时时间。

items.source: The Redis GETEX command is only available in Redis version 6.2.0 and later. Therefore, if you are not using Redis 6.2.0 or later, then it is not possible to use Spring Data Redis’s TTI expiration. A command execution exception will be thrown if you enable TTI against an incompatible Redis (server) version. No attempt is made to determine if the Redis server version is correct and supports the GETEX command.
items.translation: Redis 的 GETEX 命令仅在 Redis 6.2.0 及更高版本中可用。因此，如果您未使用 Redis 6.2.0 或更高版本，则无法使用 Spring Data Redis 的 TTI 过期功能。如果在不兼容的 Redis（服务器）版本上启用 TTI，将抛出命令执行异常。系统不会尝试判断 Redis 服务器版本是否正确以及是否支持 GETEX 命令。

items.source: In order to achieve true time-to-idle (TTI) expiration-like behavior in your Spring Data Redis application, then an entry must be consistently accessed with (TTL) expiration on every read or write operation. There are no exceptions to this rule. If you are mixing and matching different data access patterns across your Spring Data Redis application (for example: caching, invoking operations using RedisTemplate and possibly, or especially when using Spring Data Repository CRUD operations), then accessing an entry may not necessarily prevent the entry from expiring if TTL expiration was set. For example, an entry maybe "put" in (written to) the cache during a @Cacheable service method invocation with a TTL expiration (i.e. SET <expiration options>) and later read using a Spring Data Redis Repository before the expiration timeout (using GET without expiration options). A simple GET without specifying expiration options will not reset the TTL expiration timeout on an entry. Therefore, the entry may expire before the next data access operation, even though it was just read. Since this cannot be enforced in the Redis server, then it is the responsibility of your application to consistently access an entry when time-to-idle expiration is configured, in and outside of caching, where appropriate.
items.translation: 要在 Spring Data Redis 应用程序中实现真正的空闲时间（TTI）过期行为，则必须在每次读取或写入操作时一致地对条目进行访问并设置（TTL）过期时间。此规则没有例外。 如果您的 Spring Data Redis 应用程序混合使用了不同的数据访问模式（例如：缓存、使用 RedisTemplate 调用操作，以及可能尤其是使用 Spring Data Repository CRUD 操作），那么即使设置了 TTL 过期时间，访问某个条目也不一定能阻止该条目过期。 例如，一个条目可能在带有 TTL 过期时间的 @Cacheable 服务方法调用期间被“放入”（写入）缓存（即执行 SET <expiration options>），随后在过期超时之前使用 Spring Data Redis Repository 进行读取（使用不带过期选项的 GET）。 如果不指定过期选项而简单执行 GET，将不会重置条目的 TTL 过期时间。因此，即使刚刚读取了该条目，它仍可能在下次数据访问操作之前过期。 由于 Redis 服务器无法强制执行此规则，因此当配置了空闲时间过期时，您的应用程序有责任在适当的情况下，无论是在缓存内还是缓存外，一致地访问条目。

items.source: The configuration of TTI in Spring Data Redis’s Cache implementation must be explicitly enabled, that is, is opt-in. Additionally, you must also provide TTL configuration using either a fixed Duration or a custom implementation of the TtlFunction interface as described above in Redis Cache Expiration.
items.translation: Spring Data Redis 缓存实现中的 TTI 配置必须显式启用，即采用 opt-in 模式。此外，您还必须通过固定 `Duration` 或上述 `Redis Cache Expiration` 中描述的自定义 `TtlFunction` 接口实现来提供 TTL 配置。

items.source: Locking applies on the cache level, not per cache entry.
items.translation: 锁定是在缓存级别上应用的，而不是针对每个缓存条目。

items.source: By default, any key for a cache entry gets prefixed with the actual cache name followed by two colons (::). This behavior can be changed to a static as well as a computed prefix.
items.translation: 默认情况下，缓存条目的任何 `key` 都会以实际的缓存名称加上两个冒号（`::`）作为前缀。这种行为可以更改为静态前缀或计算前缀。

items.source: time-to-live (TTL) expiration - TTL is only set and reset by a create or update data access operation. As long as the entry is written before the TTL expiration timeout, including on creation, an entry’s timeout will reset to the configured duration of the TTL expiration timeout. For example, if the TTL expiration timeout is set to 5 minutes, then the timeout will be set to 5 minutes on entry creation and reset to 5 minutes anytime the entry is updated thereafter and before the 5-minute interval expires. If no update occurs within 5 minutes, even if the entry was read several times, or even just read once during the 5-minute interval, the entry will still expire. The entry must be written to prevent the entry from expiring when declaring a TTL expiration policy.
items.translation: 生存时间（TTL）过期 - TTL 仅在创建或更新数据访问操作时被设置和重置。 只要条目在 TTL 过期超时之前被写入（包括创建时），其超时时间就会重置为配置的 TTL 过期超时时长。 例如，如果 TTL 过期超时设置为 5 分钟，则在条目创建时将超时设为 5 分钟；此后在该 5 分钟间隔内任何一次更新操作都会将超时重置为 5 分钟。 如果在 5 分钟内未发生任何更新，即使在此期间读取了多次条目，甚至仅读取了一次，该条目仍会过期。 声明 TTL 过期策略时，必须写入条目以防止其过期。

items.source: time-to-idle (TTI) expiration - TTI is reset anytime the entry is also read as well as for entry updates, and is effectively and extension to the TTL expiration policy.
items.translation: 空闲超时时间（TTI）过期——TTI 在条目被读取或更新时会被重置，这实际上是对 TTL 过期策略的扩展。

items.translation: RedisCacheWriter.TtlFunction 接口是在 Spring Data Redis 3.2.0 版本中引入的。

items.source: Because Redis servers do not implement a proper notion of TTI, then TTI can only be achieved with Redis commands accepting expiration options. In Redis, the "expiration" is technically a time-to-live (TTL) policy. However, TTL expiration can be passed when reading the value of a key thereby effectively resetting the TTL expiration timeout, as is now the case in Spring Data Redis’s Cache.get(key) operation.
items.translation: 由于 Redis 服务器未实现真正的 TTI（Time To Idle）概念，因此只能通过支持过期选项的 Redis 命令来实现 TTI。 在 Redis 中，“过期”在技术上是一种时间到活（TTL）策略。 然而，可以在读取键的值时传递 TTL 过期时间，从而有效地重置 TTL 过期超时时间，正如 Spring Data Redis 中的 `Cache.get(key)` 操作当前所做的那样。

items.source: The implementation of time-to-idle (TTI) as well as time-to-live (TTL) varies in definition and behavior even across different data stores.
items.translation: 时间到空闲（TTI）和时间到生存（TTL）的实现，在不同数据存储中的定义和行为甚至存在差异。

items.source: In general:
items.translation: 一般来说：

items.source:
Some data stores expire an entry when TTL is configured no matter what type of data access operation occurs on the entry (reads, writes, or otherwise).
After the set, configured TTL expiration timeout, the entry is evicted from the data store regardless.
Eviction actions (for example: destroy, invalidate, overflow-to-disk (for persistent stores), etc.) are data store specific.
items.translation:
无论对条目执行何种类型的数据访问操作（读取、写入或其他），只要配置了 TTL，某些数据存储会在 TTL 到期时使该条目失效。  
在设置并配置的 TTL 过期超时时间到达后，该条目将被无条件地从数据存储中驱逐。  
驱逐操作（例如：销毁、使无效、持久化存储中的溢出到磁盘等）因数据存储而异。

Redis itself does not support the concept of true, time-to-idle (TTI) expiration.
Still, using Spring Data Redis’s Cache implementation, it is possible to achieve time-to-idle (TTI) expiration-like behavior.
items.translation:
Redis 本身并不支持真正的空闲时间（TTI）过期概念。  
不过，使用 Spring Data Redis 的缓存实现，可以实现类似空闲时间过期的行为。
